provenance.gate.tau_accept: frozen 2026-08-02: LFW1 YuNet STANDALONE (box-cropped) LBPH-only sweep, rank-165 unidirectional unique-pair impostor distance (9.986 ppm FAR, native predict_collect scale), reports/independence/lbph_lfw1/native_predict_scale_yunet.json. Unified with cv_only's threshold by design decision (see docs/independence/MASTER_FILE.md row 1/4 and docs/audits/STATE-08-02.md): tau_accept is a single-engine LBPH-marginal-distribution question (SFace never runs before this gate), so no joint/cascade-specific derivation is needed. The previous joint-hybrid candidate (77.769348, docs/READ THIS/FROZEN_THRESHOLDS_HYBRID.md) was NOT adopted -- it was measured on a harness bug (full-frame LBPH tiles instead of box-cropped, see cv-workspace-map SS3.2) which this session's like-for-like YuNet standalone box-crop result (67.033, nearly identical to the old Haar-standalone 67.0084) empirically confirms was the real cause of that gap, not detector choice as FROZEN_THRESHOLDS_HYBRID.md originally claimed.
provenance.gate.tau_reject: CANONIZED 2026-08-02 (advisor sign-off), value 140.13, replacing the box-crop-harness-bug-tainted 88.4927 (LFW1 YuNet joint hybrid run rank-165,226, docs/READ THIS/FROZEN_THRESHOLDS_HYBRID.md -- rejected for the same crop-mode reason gate.tau_accept's old 77.769348 candidate was). Method: docs/independence/TAU_REJECT_METHOD.md -- an FRR-vs-escalation trade-off curve (reports/independence/tau_reject_tradeoff/curve.json, script scripts/pipeline/tau_reject_tradeoff_curve.py), NOT a plain impostor-tail rank. Finding: on wild LFW, LBPH's genuine and impostor distance distributions are so overlapped in the 70-170 range that impostor-escalation tracks genuine-escalation almost 1:1 at every candidate tested (e.g. at tau_reject=100: 87.73% genuine vs 86.24% impostor escalate) -- there is no knee, i.e. no tau_reject value that meaningfully trades genuine rescue for impostor containment. 140.13 (heavy-tier p99 genuine LBPH distance, docs/experiments/tau_reject/THRESHOLD_ANALYSIS.md) sits above the observed clean/light/medium genuine distribution's near-entirety and reduces heavy-tier genuine hard-reject-before-SFace from 51.09% (old value) to ~0.5%. Framing: this is a deliberate engineering choice to make the confident-reject branch functionally inert on LFW (favoring escalation over premature hard reject, since the cascade's headline result is the SFace rescue path) -- NOT a derived separation bound, because LFW does not support one in this range. Does not apply to La Salle DB1, where LBPH separates genuine/impostor far better (docs/PAPER.md).

_hybrid_sface_band_diagnostic._note: RESOLVED 2026-08-02, no config change -- not read by load_thresholds() or any runtime path. See docs/experiments/hybrid_sface_threshold/ANALYSIS.md 'Resolution' section: on wild LFW, ~97-99% of all probes land in the escalation band regardless of tau_reject candidate, so the band-conditioned SFace population is not meaningfully different from the marginal one -- no hybrid-specific SFace threshold is defensible or needed. Closes docs/independence/MASTER_FILE.md row 5 (joint 1.0313 vs standalone 1.0306278467178345, diff 0.0007 judged immaterial). Scoped to LFW -- does NOT hold on La Salle DB1, where the escalation band is a real, much smaller subset (docs/PAPER.md's ~75%-kept-cheap figure).
_hybrid_sface_band_diagnostic.finding_corrected_2026_08_02: l2<=1.0313 implies cosine>=0.4682 (since l2=sqrt(2-2*cos) exactly), so L2 alone is the binding constraint at deployed settings -- cosine_genuine=0.363 is dead code here (it only starts to bind at l2>1.1287). The original version of this key claimed the opposite (cosine dominant); that was backwards, caught on advisor review. Corrected finding: L2 is the sole active gate, with ~6pp of headroom (81.58% -> 87.69% genuine accept) before cosine would ever engage -- moot regardless, since band ~= marginal means no hybrid-specific re-derivation is warranted in the first place.
